overview: This paper proposes CoTAM, an image codec tailored for Multimodal Large Language Models, which uses shallow CLIP attention for semantic-guided bit allocation and a multi-level fidelity decoder with a latent adapter to preserve both low-level structural details and high-level semantic context for robust cross-level feature synthesis.

modules.name: Data Preprocessing and Loading
modules.description: Handles dataset sampling, image resizing, normalization, and tensor transformations to prepare input pairs for the codec and the vision encoder.

modules.name: Base Codec Architecture
modules.description: Integrates existing variable-bitrate learned image compression backbones (e.g., ELIC, DCAE) with learnable quality vectors for dynamic rate-distortion scaling and patch-wise quantization.

modules.name: Shallow CLIP Guidance Module
modules.description: Extracts and averages attention maps from the initial layers of a frozen vision encoder, then applies a statistical quantization method to generate a discrete spatial mask for guiding the base codec's bitrate allocation.

modules.name: Hierarchical Guidance Extension
modules.description: Fuses global downsampled attention maps with local patch-level attention maps to create a comprehensive guidance signal, enabling the codec to handle high-resolution inputs without losing global semantic context.

modules.name: Latent Feature Adapter and Reconstruction Prior
modules.description: Implements a lightweight transformer block that operates on decoded latent codes to generate semantic enhancement features, which are then fused with patch embeddings extracted from the decoded image prior.

modules.name: Multi-Level Fidelity Loss
modules.description: Computes weighted fidelity constraints by comparing features of the original and processed images extracted from both the shallow layers (structural details) and the final layer (global semantics) of a frozen vision encoder.

modules.name: CoTAM Model Assembly
modules.description: Constructs the end-to-end pipeline integrating the guided encoder, the base codec quantization, the bitstream, and the fidelity-preserving decoder with the reconstruction prior.

modules.name: Training Strategy and Loop
modules.description: Manages the phased training protocol, including an initialization phase using low-level loss constraints followed by joint optimization, as well as gradient management and optimizer scheduling.

modules.name: MLLM Benchmark Evaluation
modules.description: Executes inference on multimodal benchmarks (e.g., MME, MMBench, Video-MME) using downstream MLLMs to assess task performance on compressed visual inputs across diverse capabilities like OCR, counting, and reasoning.

modules.name: Reconstruction and Efficiency Analysis
modules.description: Calculates image fidelity metrics (PSNR), bitrate savings (BD-Rate) relative to anchor codecs, and computational overhead (encoding/decoding latency) to evaluate compression efficiency.

modules.name: Feature Flow Visualization
modules.description: Generates visual diagnostics including attention maps, PCA feature projections, and token cosine similarity plots to validate the three-stage information processing model and the impact of compression.

modules.name: Experiment Management and Ablation
modules.description: Provides configuration handling, experiment tracking, and controlled execution environments for component ablation studies (e.g., removing adapter, guidance, or reconstruction prior) and sensitivity analysis.
